tick_to_axis.desc: 刻度文字近轴边缘 → 轴线（刻度在内侧时为负，取绝对值）

origin.why: Historical measurement; observational only, verify source and applicability.

axis_title_x_to_axis.desc: 横轴标题顶 → 横轴线（含刻度行占位，故比刻度间距大一个量级）

origin.why: Historical measurement; observational only, verify source and applicability.

axis_title_y_to_axis.desc: 纵轴标题右缘 → 纵轴线（含刻度列占位）

origin.why: Historical measurement; observational only, verify source and applicability.

category_to_axis.desc: 类目名（横轴非数字标签）底 → 横轴线

origin.why: Historical measurement; observational only, verify source and applicability.

category_to_axis_title.desc: 类目名底 → 横轴标题顶

origin.why: Historical measurement; observational only, verify source and applicability.

legend_to_plot.desc: 图例整体（含样例线/色块）最近边 → 绘图区边界

origin.why: Historical measurement; observational only, verify source and applicability.

legend_swatch_to_text.desc: 图例样例（线样/色块）右缘 → 图例文字左缘

origin.why: Historical measurement; observational only, verify source and applicability.

legend_row_pitch.desc: 图例相邻两行的行距（基线到基线）

origin.why: Historical measurement; observational only, verify source and applicability.

value_label_to_element.desc: 数值标签底 → 其所标注的元素（柱顶/点）

origin.why: Historical measurement; observational only, verify source and applicability.

plot_to_canvas.desc: 墨迹最近边 → 画布边（导出裁切后的四边留白）

origin.why: Historical measurement; observational only, verify source and applicability.

subplot_gap.desc: 上下叠排子图之间的间隙（上一子图 x 轴标题底 → 下一子图绘图区顶）

origin.why: Historical measurement; observational only, verify source and applicability.

legend_to_graphic.desc: 图例整体 → 无坐标轴图形（雷达/环形/示意）的最外缘（含四周标签）

origin.why: Historical measurement; observational only, verify source and applicability.
